label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Use a Real Reply-to Email Address
body: Encourage connection by using a human-monitored email address, not 'no-reply', so people can easily reach you.
caption:
When you send emails, make sure the 'reply-to' address is one you actually check. It's a small detail that makes a big difference in building trust and fostering community. Your subscribers will feel more comfortable asking questions or sharing thoughts, knowing their message won't disappear into a digital void. It shows you're open to communication and value their input. Check your email settings
